Congrats to Stasi and thanks for doing a good job as the Commissioner of Education!


Polk State College (@PolkState)

Polk State College names Anastasios “Stasi” Kamoutsas as its sixth president polk.edu/news/polk-state-col…

Absurd!


Polymarket (@Polymarket)

NEW: California officials warn final LA mayoral election results could take weeks, with only 54% of votes counted.



— https://nitter.net/Polymarket/status/2062317638836015336#m

Florida processes more than 10 million votes in a matter of hours.

California takes days — or sometimes even weeks — to count the votes.  

It’s pathetic — and it’s corrosive to our civic culture.


Mr. Saito (@Mr_Saito_)

Sad to see you post this. Who exactly is ‘dumping votes?’



— https://nitter.net/Mr_Saito_/status/2062334545437806926#m

Wow, what a year he’s having.


Just Baseball (@JustBB_Media)

HISTORY!

Cristopher Sanchez now owns the longest scoreless innings streak by any lefty EVER 🔔





— https://nitter.net/JustBB_Media/status/2062307247305146481#m

California keeps dumping votes.  Odds are shifting because the vote dumps always seem to go one way.

Count until you get the result you want?


Polymarket (@Polymarket)

JUST IN: Spencer Pratt drops to third in LA mayoral odds, trailing Mayor Bass & Democratic Socialist Nithya Raman.







— https://nitter.net/Polymarket/status/2062270690032501171#m

When someone goes to the state for welfare assistance, the individual’s needs are put into the CarePortal, which sends out the information to all the organizations — religious, charitable, business — that are participants in Hope Florida. 

These organizations (that are all exterior to government) can then respond to the needs.  This both saves taxpayer dollars and provides much better help.  Many of the people who have been served have eliminated their need for government assistance entirely.

Is it incompetence or is it intentional?


Joshua (@RealJoshPerry)

Taking days or weeks to count basic primary ballots is the definition of institutional incompetence.

There is no logical reason a developed state should operate its voting infrastructure like a third-world country. 

If Florida can run massive elections flawlessly in a single evening, California has zero excuses.



— https://nitter.net/RealJoshPerry/status/2062123325724233763#m
I’m sure the massive, post-election vote dumps will boost leftist candidates.  Taking days or weeks to count votes and announce the results is a joke.

There are also a lot of people who also don’t realize:

—the majority of residential property tax revenue taken by local governments is non-homestead residential properties
—homestead property tax revenue is a fraction of all property tax revenue which also includes commercial properties
—property tax revenue is a fraction of total revenue for large counties
—property tax revenue taken by local governments has nearly doubled in the past eight years


Eben Brown (FOX) 🇺🇸 (@FoxEbenBrown)

It’s ama

Good one, Bob!


Bob Rommel (@bob_rommel)

Where was TaxWatch the last 7 years when local government was spending 300% above inflation.

  




— https://nitter.net/bob_rommel/status/2062139606200422539#m

Depends on the time of the year…


Josh Barzon (@JoshuaBarzon)

You just won a 2-week, all-expenses-paid vacation to Florida. But there’s a catch: you have to stay within one region the whole time. What are you picking?





— https://nitter.net/JoshuaBarzon/status/2061874422902849691#m

Basically.


Scott M  (@NSDarkHorse)

The counting will continue until the desired outcome is reached!



— https://nitter.net/NSDarkHorse/status/2062125590606430588#m

Wouldn’t surprise me.


Nole042515 (@nole042515)

I’m worried they are going to “find” all these “votes” and cheat their way to pushing out Hilton & Pratt. California is such a mess. So sad for them, but also their own fault. We are going to miss having you, the best Governor EVER, when your term is over.



— https://nitter.net/nole042515/status/2062123743367864581#m

Gehrig would have lit it up through 1941 had he not been stricken by ALS.  

Once the war started who knows what would have happened.  

But 1937-41 would have been five banner years — and another three World Series wins (NYY would have won in 1940 with a healthy Gehrig IMO).


Red County in Blue State #2A #RealBaseball (@JSD12120831)
